verdict.rationale: Twilio's own docs show automatic event handling. Voice can respond to incoming calls, gather input and record "without needing a person," and Event Streams delivers a real-time feed of Twilio events to multiple destinations. Neither is documented as a user-defined rules engine with conditions and actions; both are closer to programmable event handling and event forwarding. missing for 10: an explicit user-configurable rule or condition-action builder, documentation of trigger conditions and the range of available actions, independent or hands-on corroboration of rule-based automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: respond to incoming phone calls, gather user input, record calls, and take payments without needing a person to answer the phone
Get a unified, real-time feed of all Twilio events and interactions streamed to multiple destinations.
